fusions.name: Draw It Out
fusions.desc: A thrust at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 15 piercing damage and uses up every one of your afflictions on it. It adds their remaining damage to the blow and deals 60% more for each one used up.

fusions.name: Kept at Arm's Length
fusions.desc: A thrust at a target up to 4 tiles away for 4 piercing damage, up to 1.3 times that at full reach. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Damped], dealing less damage, for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Lance the Wound
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you and from each of your allies.

fusions.name: Bitter Return
fusions.desc: Each affliction laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it. You have 10% poison resistance.
